matching_rule: Exactly one specification per planned source-document ID; no extras.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Restricted cover, version control, persons/non-operative charges, observation/description/procedure/media chronology, identity-source matrix, issues, applications and deadlines; neutral orientation.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 12-18 pages; 300-500 words/narrative page and 10-22 sourced events/table page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital accessible PDF; searchable text, stable links and repeated headers; no scanned summary.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Unresolved identity fields and revised procedure chronology permitted with dated version history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Witness contact, foil and restricted media data minimised by audience; client version uses neutral plain language.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No copied statements, generic Turnbull text, repeated chronology, decorative face grids or blank padding.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: restricted identifiers absent from client/open variants

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Incident and witness section containing signed first accounts, exact first descriptions, observation-condition fields, later statements/clarifications, intervening exposure and availability history; preserves evolution without hindsight.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 25-35 pages; statements 250-450 words/page and description/comparison tables 8-18 rows/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Signed scanned statements and born-digital comparison tables; original wording/order/page identifiers preserved.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Natural inconsistency, uncertain estimate, spelling correction and later clarification retained separately; no retrospective harmonisation.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Addresses/contact and vulnerable details restricted; relevant statements served; client output avoids witness contact data.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated summaries, invented certainty scales, duplicate declarations, generic witness guidance or empty continuation pages.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: observation fields complete or missing state explicit

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: PACE Code D/video-identification suite: requirement/decision record, administrator appointment and independence, suspect notice/response, image-set and foil register, witness instructions, procedure audit, exact responses and deviation log.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 28-40 pages; forms retain authentic whitespace, registers 6-16 entries/page and procedure narrative 250-450 words/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital procedure records and image-set register; native moving-image set external; signed notices/scans permitted; foil images controlled and not decorative.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Foil objection, rescheduled procedure, technical interruption and corrected audit entry legitimate when documented; procedure master unchanged.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Foil identities/images and witness contact restricted; authorised legal/court access only; client gets procedure explanation, not reusable foil data.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated foil grids, fabricated witness responses, duplicate blank notices, cosmetic procedure versions or one image/page padding.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: CCTV acquisition/continuity, camera register, native metadata, master/clip/still/enhancement lineage, selected stills and image-quality expert report; evaluates visibility and derivative limits, not identity.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 30-42 pages; camera tables 8-18 rows/page, expert narrative 300-500 words/page and 1-4 necessary images/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Native video external; born-digital registers/report; images retain aspect ratio/pixel dimensions; enhancement derivatives never overwrite master.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Low light, compression, occlusion, clock offset, variable frame rate and revised expert addendum are legitimate and explicit.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Bystander and location-security data restricted; full-resolution media role-limited; client/court receive authorised derivatives with warnings.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated near-identical frames, invented enhancement detail, stretched crops, decorative filters, face labels or one-frame-per-page padding.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: redactions do not obscure relevant quality

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Scene and observation-condition record: plans, scaled maps, photographs, lighting/weather source, sightlines, distance/duration estimates, obstructions and timed walk-through methodology; reconstructs opportunity to observe.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 15-24 pages; one plan/map or 1-4 photographs/page, measurement tables 8-20 rows/page and methodology 250-450 words/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital scaled plan and tables; ordinary scene photographs with metadata; scanned contemporaneous sketch may be included and linked, never redrawn as authoritative without label.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Estimated position, seasonal lighting difference, temporary obstruction and corrected scale note permitted with explicit limitation.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Private addresses/security details minimised; full scene plan limited to authorised users; client/open outputs use necessary crop.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No decorative maps, repeated photographs, simulated exact sightlines, generic lighting prose or unused blank measurement tables.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: map does not imply certainty beyond source

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Custody/interview audio index/transcript, defence statement, alibi notice/witness account, transport/payment/phone timing records and reconciliation table; records defence and independent timing evidence.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 20-30 pages; transcript 35-70 turns/page, statements 250-450 words/page and timing tables 10-24 rows/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Native audio and provider data external; born-digital transcript/tables; signed scans for statements; records rendered without changing raw times/IDs.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Inaudible word, incomplete alibi period, timezone correction and later provider record allowed with history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Privileged attendance/advice excluded; alibi witness contact and account details restricted; served material only to CPS/court.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated interview excerpts, invented travel records, generic alibi prose, duplicate tables or empty journey rows.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: record owner not equated with user without evidence

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Prosecution/defence image or identification expert reports, materials, methods, addenda and joint issues extract; limits opinions to image quality/procedure-related expertise and records dated agreement/disagreement.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 18-28 pages; reports 300-550 words/page, method/result tables 6-16 rows/page and only necessary demonstratives.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital signed reports; demonstratives source-linked and resolution-preserving; technical data appendices concise.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Provisional opinion, late master receipt, corrected image dimension and unresolved disagreement retained with version history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Reports served by state; instructions/attendance notes privileged; foil/bystander images controlled; client receives accessible explanation.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No generic CV pages, repeated image plates, facial-recognition claim without authorised discipline, duplicate methods or decorative overlays.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: joint statement governs only recorded issues/date

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Disclosure schedules, Code D/exclusion and no-case applications/responses/rulings, identification directions, hearing notices/orders, witness attendance and deadline tracker; maintains procedural and count states.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 28-40 pages; schedules 10-24 rows/page, applications 250-500 words/page and event/deadline tables 8-18 rows/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital schedules/forms/directions; signed/scanned court orders where realistic; stable row and application IDs.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Revised application, late media service, adjourned hearing, partial ruling and amended direction permitted with full history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Sensitive witness/foil data and internal/privileged advice role-limited; client/open versions contain authorised procedural facts only.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No copied legal tests, boilerplate schedule rows, duplicate notices/directions, invented rulings or blank forms.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: excluded material absent from merits outputs
